title: Kelvin–Helmholtz billows
alt: A pale band of dye between two shear layers whose edges roll up into rows of spirals, outlined by a thin yellow-green line.
caption: Passive dye between two shear layers rolling up, Re = 400, t = 2 to 9.95. 384 × 192 Fourier modes, RK443, dt = 0.0025, CPU.
loop: run frames, then a 0.5 s cross-fade from the last frame to the first

title: Rayleigh–Taylor instability
alt: Dark heavy fluid falls into pale light fluid in mushroom-shaped fingers that roll up and mix, while pale plumes rise.
caption: Heavy fluid falling into light fluid, Ra 1e7, computed with Conatus.
loop: fade from black over the first 7 frames and to black over the last 7 (the mixed end state is not the start state)
